name: Seifuku Sareta Onna Touzoku Dan
source:
A group of female thieves named "Poison Stage."
On the surface, they seemed to be getting along well with each other, but inside their mind they had evil thoughts.
And a conspiracy of one of its members destroyed the team, and the ex-principal members became men's plaything one by one.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE089122.html]DLsite english[/url]]
